actions.publish_message.description: Publishes one message to a Kafka topic and returns its partition and offset.
actions.publish_message.props.headers.de: Optional text headers, for example source = checkout.
actions.publish_message.props.key.descri: Optional message key. Messages with the same key stay in order on one partition.
Optional partition number, starting at 0. Leave empty to let Kafka choose from the key.
actions.publish_message.props.topic.desc: Topic to publish to, for example orders.
actions.publish_message.props.value.desc: Message body sent as UTF-8 text. For JSON, paste the JSON document.
actions.publish_messages.description: Publishes several messages to a Kafka topic in one step and returns a partition and offset for each.
Messages published in order. Each result includes that message key, partition, and offset.
actions.publish_messages.props.topic.des: Topic to publish to, for example orders.
auth.description: Connect with bootstrap servers and SASL or SSL credentials.
auth.props.brokers.description: Comma-separated host:port pairs, for example kafka-1.internal:9092, kafka-2.internal:9092.
auth.props.caCertificate.description: Optional PEM CA certificate for a private certificate authority. Used with SSL and SASL_SSL.
auth.props.password.description: SASL password. Required for SASL_SSL and SASL_PLAINTEXT.
auth.props.rejectUnauthorized.descriptio: Applies to SSL and SASL_SSL. Keep this on. For a private or self-signed certificate, paste its CA certificate instead. Turning this off disables certificate checks and is unsafe outside testing.
auth.props.saslMechanism.description: Required for SASL_SSL and SASL_PLAINTEXT. Ignored for SSL and PLAINTEXT.
auth.props.securityProtocol.description: How the worker connects to the brokers.
auth.props.setup.description:
1. Copy the cluster bootstrap servers as host:port pairs, separated by commas. Example: kafka-1.internal:9092, kafka-2.internal:9092.
2. Choose the security protocol the cluster uses.
3. For SASL_PLAINTEXT or SASL_SSL, choose the mechanism and enter the username and password.
4. For SSL or SASL_SSL, leave server certificate verification on unless the cluster uses a private CA. Paste that CA in the certificate field.
auth.props.username.description: SASL username. Required for SASL_SSL and SASL_PLAINTEXT.
description: Publish and consume messages on an Apache Kafka cluster.
triggers.new_message.description: Reads each new message on a topic, including its payload, key, partition, and offset. Messages are marked as read before the flow runs, so if a run fails, that message is not delivered again.
triggers.new_message.props.consumerGroup: Kafka consumer group id, for example activepieces-orders. Use a different group for each flow that should receive every message. Flows that share a group split the topic between them. Testing the trigger uses a temporary group whose name starts with this id plus -activepieces-test-, so a group ACL must be PREFIXED and allow Read and Delete (Delete removes the temporary group after the test).
triggers.new_message.props.maxMessages.d: Maximum messages to read each time the flow checks the topic. Each message starts its own run. Whole number from 1 to 500.
triggers.new_message.props.pollTimeoutSe: Longest time one check spends reading. A check with no new messages ends at once. Whole number from 1 to 20.
triggers.new_message.props.startFrom.des: Used only when this consumer group has no committed offset yet. New messages only skips history. Beginning of the topic reads what is still retained.
triggers.new_message.props.topic.descrip: Topic to read, for example orders.
triggers.new_messages_batch.description: Reads a batch of new messages on a topic in one run. Messages are marked as read before the flow runs, so if a run fails, those messages are not delivered again.
triggers.new_messages_batch.props.consum: Kafka consumer group id, for example activepieces-orders. Use a different group for each flow that should receive every message. Flows that share a group split the topic between them. Testing the trigger uses a temporary group whose name starts with this id plus -activepieces-test-, so a group ACL must be PREFIXED and allow Read and Delete (Delete removes the temporary group after the test).
triggers.new_messages_batch.props.maxMes: Maximum messages included in one batch. Whole number from 1 to 500.
triggers.new_messages_batch.props.pollTi: Longest time one check spends reading. A check with no new messages ends at once. Whole number from 1 to 20.
triggers.new_messages_batch.props.startF: Used only when this consumer group has no committed offset yet. New messages only skips history. Beginning of the topic reads what is still retained.
Topic to read, for example orders.
